question: Prior art? Shorter preprint titles get more citations because they are easier to retrieve.

S1.title: Title length and citation counts across fields

S2.title: Search-engine retrieval of scholarly records by title terms

S4.title: A study the verifier could not confirm

S6.title: Title wording and click-through in scholarly search

claims.text: Shorter titles are associated with more citations in several fields.
Retrieval rank depends on title term matches.
Journal prestige explains most of the title-length association.
Title length has no association with citations.
Title wording affects click-through in search results.
